brief:
Israel has stopped allowing commercial goods into Gaza for two days, creating acute food affordability concerns in the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. Fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, and winter clothing have not crossed into Gaza during the halt.

The blockade on commercial imports threatens to worsen an already dire humanitarian situation as residents face shortages of essential supplies amid winter conditions.
dek: Commercial goods, such as fresh fruit, vegetables, meat and winter clothing, have not entered Gaza for two days.
title: Israel halts commercial goods entry to Gaza
